articles.summary: Bennie Schamp, Senior Director Service Poultry at JBT Marel, discusses the importance of preventive maintenance, which is increasingly being recognized by more processors. “Over the years, a lot has changed regarding equipment and the market. With higher line speeds and longer production times, reactive service is no longer sufficient. More and more customers are therefore opting for preventive maintenance schedules. Preventive maintenance focuses on the timely replacement of critical parts to keep machines performing stably at a high level and to reduce the risk of unexpected downtime.”
articles.title: Why and when is preventive maintenance necessary?
